title.en: Frank-Egedal hot-ion velocity and pitch moments
title.zh: Frank-Egedal 热离子速度与俯仰矩

summary: Integrate one explicitly defined nonnegative reference population over a common speed domain for density and both pressure moments.

capability: Frank-Egedal hot-ion velocity and pitch moments
Integrate one explicitly defined nonnegative reference population over a common speed domain for density and both pressure moments.
operation: (magnetic_field, params, degrees, source_coefficients, legendre_terms, fractional_mode) -> normalized_field, xi_tp_mid, hot_parallel_shape, hot_perpendicular_shape, hot_density_shape, quadrature
discovery.model: Mathematical moments of the stated nonnegative part of a finite-mode reference distribution. It is not an independently established exact Frank-Egedal kinetic solution or measured plasma population.
discovery.geometry: A positive two-dimensional local magnetic-field magnitude on caller-supplied [Z,R] samples; no field-line geometry or spatial metric is computed.
discovery.boundary: Common s_min=velocity_lower, falling back to legacy perp_velocity_lower, then zero; 0<=s_min<1. For b<1, inaccessible reference orbits xi<sqrt(1-b) carry zero supplied population, instead of clipping imaginary xi0 to zero. For vc=0,s_min=0 a nonzero nonnegative density diverges logarithmically and is rejected.

identity.relation: Local magnetic-field magnitude and source angular modes to normalized hot-ion density and pressure shapes
identity.direction: (magnetic_field, params, degrees, source_coefficients, legendre_terms, fractional_mode) -> normalized_field, xi_tp_mid, hot_parallel_shape, hot_perpendicular_shape, hot_density_shape, quadrature
identity.definition: Let b=B/B0, xi_max=sqrt(max(0,1-b/R)), xi_min=sqrt(max(0,1-b)), and xi0=sqrt((xi^2-(1-b))/b). Only xi_min<=xi<=xi_max belongs to the population specified at B0; for b>=R moments are zero. With s=v/v0 in the common interval [s_min,1], f=max(sum_j c_j*u_nu_j(xi0)*U(s)^(nu_j*(nu_j+1))/(s^3+vc^3),0), U(s)=[(1+vc^3)*s^3/(s^3+vc^3)]^(beta_m/3). Compute n=4*pi*integral s^2*f ds dxi, P_parallel=4*pi*integral s^4*xi^2*f ds dxi and P_perp=2*pi*integral s^4*(1-xi^2)*f ds dxi over the SAME domain. Normalize both pressures to P_parallel(b=1), density to n(b=1), requiring positive finite normalizers. Refine raw quadrature before dividing. For a zero lower cutoff and vc>0, factor the least active speed power q=min(beta_m*nu*(nu+1)) and, when q>-3, use a Gauss-Jacobi density weight v^(2+q); evaluate remaining nonnegative powers explicitly. This resolves integrable endpoint singularities without separately overflowing f and underflowing v^2.
identity.model: Mathematical moments of the stated nonnegative part of a finite-mode reference distribution. It is not an independently established exact Frank-Egedal kinetic solution or measured plasma population.
identity.geometry: A positive two-dimensional local magnetic-field magnitude on caller-supplied [Z,R] samples; no field-line geometry or spatial metric is computed.
identity.coordinates: The input axes and returned shape-field axes are [Z,R]. Speed is normalized by v0; xi is the implementation's nonnegative pitch cosine, and xi0 is mapped to the reference field. B0 is a field magnitude in T; all returned shape fields are dimensionless.
identity.boundary: Common s_min=velocity_lower, falling back to legacy perp_velocity_lower, then zero; 0<=s_min<1. For b<1, inaccessible reference orbits xi<sqrt(1-b) carry zero supplied population, instead of clipping imaginary xi0 to zero. For vc=0,s_min=0 a nonzero nonnegative density diverges logarithmically and is rejected.
assumptions: All three moments describe the same population and integration domain.
The nonnegative-part operation is part of this explicit finite-mode model; no exact untruncated kinetic-solution claim is made.

Frank2509.17288v4 Eq16 uses common speed support, while Eq19b prints a perpendicular-only critical-speed lower bound. This implementation follows the stated common-population moment definition; an author-confirmed erratum is not established.
Changing the legacy perp_velocity_lower now changes density and parallel moments as well; this is a scientific behavior correction, not numerical compatibility with the earlier inconsistent tensor.

inputs.name: magnetic_field
inputs.shape: [N_Z,N_R] two-dimensional array; an empty axis is accepted when an explicit valid B0 is supplied
inputs.constraints: Every present value finite and strictly positive; B0 must also be positive. Without explicit B0 an empty field yields an invalid reference median.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Intentional scalar model, compatibility and quadrature controls: B0, mirror_ratio/turning_b, vc_over_v0, velocity_lower (legacy alias perp_velocity_lower), beta_m/zeff, initial velocity_nodes/pitch_nodes, quadrature_rtol and max_quadrature_nodes. These defaults are declared caller contract, not inferred measurements.
inputs.units: B0: T; ratios and beta_m: dimensionless; nodes: count
inputs.dtype: mapping with get and numeric-convertible selected values
inputs.constraints: B0 defaults to median(B) and must be positive. mirror_ratio falls back to turning_b and then 2, and must be finite >1; mirror_ratio takes precedence when both names are supplied. vc_over_v0 defaults to 0.25 and must be finite >=0. velocity_lower falls back to perp_velocity_lower and then 0, lies in [0,1), and both speed-lower names must agree when supplied. vc=0 with lower=0 has divergent density and is rejected; positive lower retains vc=0. beta_m falls back to zeff/2 and then 0.5, and must be finite; beta_m takes precedence when both names are supplied. Initial velocity_nodes and pitch_nodes int-convert to >=2 and default to 24. quadrature_rtol defaults to 1e-7 and must be positive. max_quadrature_nodes defaults to max(768,2*max(initial counts)) and must allow at least one refinement. Negative beta is not uniformly excluded, but unresolved/nonintegrable raw moments fail convergence.

inputs.name: degrees
inputs.description: Fractional angular-mode degrees paired with source_coefficients.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative, shape matched with source_coefficients.

inputs.name: source_coefficients
inputs.constraints: Finite and exactly the same shape as degrees; sign is not restricted.

inputs.name: legendre_terms
inputs.description: Retained term count passed through to fractional_mode.
inputs.dtype: not converted or validated by this operator
inputs.constraints: Passed unchanged to each mode call; the supplied callable owns its validity checks.

inputs.name: fractional_mode
inputs.description: Angular-mode evaluator called as fractional_mode(degree, xi0, legendre_terms).
inputs.shape: callable returning values broadcast-compatible with the speed-by-pitch quadrature grid
inputs.dtype: callable; returned values participate in float-array arithmetic
inputs.constraints: No preflight callable or finite-output check; exceptions, shape errors and nonfinite mode values may propagate.

outputs.name: normalized_field
outputs.description: Input B divided by selected reference B0.
outputs.constraints: Positive and finite on validated finite inputs.

outputs.name: xi_tp_mid
outputs.constraints: Strictly between zero and one for a valid finite mirror_ratio >1.

outputs.name: hot_parallel_shape
outputs.description: Parallel pressure moment divided by the reference parallel moment.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside the supplied accessible pitch support. Reference pressure/density normalizers must be finite and positive; no floor replaces a zero normalizer.

outputs.name: hot_perpendicular_shape
outputs.description: Perpendicular pressure moment divided by the reference parallel, not perpendicular, moment.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside the supplied accessible pitch support. Reference pressure/density normalizers must be finite and positive; no floor replaces a zero normalizer.

outputs.name: hot_density_shape
outputs.description: Density moment divided by the reference density moment.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside the supplied accessible pitch support. Reference pressure/density normalizers must be finite and positive; no floor replaces a zero normalizer.

outputs.name: quadrature
outputs.constraints: Effective refined counts and agreement tolerance are separately reported in quadrature_convergence.

outputs.name: velocity_domain
outputs.description: Common speed domain of all three moments.

outputs.name: quadrature_convergence
outputs.constraints: Reports effective velocity_nodes, pitch_nodes, relative_tolerance and raw_moments_checked=True; finite-rule agreement is an estimate, not a proof for arbitrary angular callbacks. velocity_rule records Jacobi-factored or ordinary Legendre evaluation, with factored_density_power when applicable.

outputs.name: reference_raw_moments
outputs.description: Raw dimensionless parallel, perpendicular and density moments at B/B0=1 before normalization.
outputs.units: dimensionless in the stated normalized distribution
outputs.shape: mapping with parallel, perpendicular and density
outputs.constraints: Finite positive parallel and density normalizers; records the explicitly defined moment integrals rather than an independent physical validation.

preconditions: A finite nonzero integrable supplied reference population and positive B/B0.
Caller-supplied angular function and coefficients have a stated common normalization and support.
supported: Common full or truncated speed populations, including vc=0 with positive lower cutoff.
Fields below, at and above B0 with the explicitly supplied accessible-orbit support.
Finite negative beta cases when raw-moment refinement converges.
excluded: Unspecified populations on orbits that cannot reach B0, arbitrary callback feature discovery, zero normalizers and divergent or unresolved integrals.
A claim that the printed Eq19b discrepancy has been confirmed as an author erratum.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid field/configuration/degrees, conflicting speed aliases, the logarithmically divergent zero-vc zero-cutoff density or nonpositive normalizers.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite distribution values; callback errors propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: RuntimeError when doubled raw-moment rules fail the requested tolerance before max_quadrature_nodes; normalized ratios are never used to conceal raw divergence.

example.description: Check a common constant-mode population at reference field and below it.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.frank_egedal_hot_ion_moments import evaluate_frank_egedal_hot_ion_moments
r=evaluate_frank_egedal_hot_ion_moments([[1.,.25]],{'B0':1.,'mirror_ratio':4.,'beta_m':0.,'velocity_lower':.2},[0.],[1.],2,lambda degree,xi,terms:np.ones_like(xi))
a=np.sqrt(.75);lo=np.sqrt(.75);hi=np.sqrt(1-.25/4)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['hot_density_shape'],[[1.,(hi-lo)/a]],rtol=2e-11)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['hot_perpendicular_shape'][0,0],1.5,rtol=2e-11)
assert r['velocity_domain']['common_to_density_and_both_pressures']
example.expected: Observed PASS: The reference perpendicular-to-parallel ratio is 1.5 for this finite cone, and below-B0 density only counts orbits reaching the reference plane.

scope: Declared defaults and legacy-alias precedence, including exact default-versus-explicit result regressions and the default quadrature node cap.
Thirty-six independent polynomial moment/support cases, including b<1, closed cone and vc=0 with positive cutoff.
A divergent negative-beta raw density is rejected while a demonstrated integrable negative-beta input remains supported.
Independent 70-digit incomplete-Beta raw-moment values for degree 2 and beta=-0.1,-0.3,-0.4,-0.4999,0,0.5, including near the density-integrability boundary.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to the declared relation: Let b=B/B0, xi_max=sqrt(max(0,1-b/R)), xi_min=sqrt(max(0,1-b)), and xi0=sqrt((xi^2-(1-b))/b). Only xi_min<=xi<=xi_max belongs to the population specified at B0; for b>=R moments are zero…. Evidence: test_spectral_scientific_correction.py, test_frank_egedal_hot_ion_moments.py (25 recorded test functions; shared-file plus direct composition/test coverage; independent analytic/high-precision oracle); the contract example ran. Excluded scope: Unspecified populations on orbits that cannot reach B0, arbitrary callback feature discovery, zero normalizers and divergent or unresolved integrals; A claim that the printed Eq19b discrepancy has been confirmed as an author erratum.
known_limitations: The positive part of a finite modal sum is an explicitly modified mathematical model; arbitrary mode truncation does not establish physical positivity or kinetic equivalence.
Raw quadrature refinement is a finite numerical agreement test and cannot discover arbitrary unresolved caller-function features.
The common-domain correction changes legacy density/parallel values when perp_velocity_lower was set.
The bounded probes cover declared defaults, representative relation and limit cases, but do not establish arbitrary callback features or physical calibration of the defaults.
